novelty.new_evidence_axis: Parsed sequential 13D/A stake-change direction versus the prior same issuer-holder PIT parsed row; this is not raw 13D metadata, static classPercent, holder-type, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional retuning.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior metadata-only 13D/13G runs failed and exp-20260618-016 found no clean static holder/stake subset, but it explicitly left stake-change direction as a new evidence axis. The local parsed 13D amendment cache has adequate rows to test accumulation direction without using LLM or future information.

execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing parsed 13D rows, missing prior same issuer-holder parsed row, non-positive stake change, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT parsed 13D/A stake-change direction, acceptance-time signal date, price-absorption gate, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The parsed 13D/A stake-increase absorption source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, target_sample_too_small, accepted_compression_ev_not_beaten, accepted_compression_pnl_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_ev_not_beaten, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). The fixed bundle tested only positive sequential stake-change direction plus signal-day SPY-relative price absorption. The result is not retained or promoted.
post_run_reflection.outcome_summary: Aggregate EV delta +0.0210; aggregate PnL delta $+405.94; max drawdown drift +0.0003; 19 paper trades.
post_run_reflection.negative_reflection: A negative result means the parsed 13D/A ownership increase is still too stale, too sparse, or too issuer-control-heavy after next-open execution and price absorption. The field is useful as ownership context, but not sufficient entry timing evidence.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping stake-delta thresholds, classPercent thresholds, holder type, Big-3 exclusions, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: If this fixed stake-increase direction source fails, do not retry by sweeping stake-delta thresholds, classPercent thresholds, holder type, Big-3 exclusions, signal excess, close-location, volume, volatility, ret20, price/ADV, event-age, top-N, hold days, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows. A valid retry needs 13G/A stake-change direction coverage, 13D Item 4 purpose-text classification, repaired old_thin structured XML coverage, or closed forward replacement-value rows.
